headline: CSN Appoints Former Cosan Chief Mario Augusto da Silva as CFO
summary: CSN's board of directors elected Mario Augusto da Silva as the company's new chief financial officer, effective December 1.
why: CFO appointments in large industrial conglomerates signal shifts in financial governance, capital allocation, and debt management strategies.
